panel.title: 🧪 Kiza Launcher — Accès Alpha
panel.description:
Merci pour ton intérêt pour **Kiza Launcher** ! 💜

L’Alpha est une étape importante du développement de Kiza. Nous recherchons des joueurs motivés pour **tester le launcher, essayer ses fonctionnalités et nous transmettre des retours sincères et détaillés**.

Si tu souhaites participer, remplis le formulaire de candidature ci-dessous. Une seule candidature active est autorisée par personne.

questions.label: Why would you like to participate?
questions.description: And what would you especially like to test in Kiza?
questions.placeholder: Motivation, mods, instances, installation, performance, design, stability…

questions.label: Which Minecraft version do you use?
questions.description: And which tools: Forge, Fabric, NeoForge, OptiFine, other launchers.
questions.placeholder: e.g. 1.21.1, Fabric, CurseForge and Modrinth — describe your habits.

questions.label: What are your PC specs?
questions.description: And what would you do if Kiza crashed when launching an instance?
questions.placeholder: Windows, RAM, CPU, GPU, then the checks and information you would provide.

questions.label: Will you be able to test regularly?
questions.description: Report bugs with details and logs, and give honest feedback.
questions.placeholder: Availability, testing frequency, and how you would provide feedback.

questions.label: Do you agree to test an Alpha version?
questions.description: It may contain bugs, crashes and incomplete features.
questions.placeholder: Clearly confirm that you understand and agree.
